question: Penkuni Festival is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kerala**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Painkuni Festival is celebrated in Kerala, India**
 
• The festival takes place at the Sree Padmanabha Swamy Temple in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala
 
• The festival is celebrated in March or April 
 
• The festival is a 10-day celebration
 
• The festival is closely associated with the Royal Family of Travancore
